grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān méi yǒu dài qián.
grammar.english: I didn't bring any money today.

grammar.markup: {我}{有时候}{下班}{以后}{去}{健身房}。
grammar.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shí hou xià bān yǐ hòu qù jiàn shēn fáng.
grammar.english: I sometimes go to the gym after work.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zhōu mò cháng cháng qù pān yán.
grammar.english: I often go climbing on weekends.

grammar.pinyin: Cóng zhè lǐ zǒu lù guò qu bù yuǎn.
grammar.english: It's not far to walk there from here.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué yī mén wài yǔ.
grammar.english: I want to learn a foreign language.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zài mén kǒu děng nǐ.
grammar.english: I'll wait for you at the entrance.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xià zhōu fàng jià.
Zhè jiā cān tīng hěn yǒu míng.
Wǒ xū yào shàng wǎng chá yí xià.
grammar.english: I need to go online and check something.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐ sài, tā de le shí fēn.
grammar.english: He scored ten points in this match.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zài jiā xiū xi.
grammar.english: I want to rest at home today.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de fú wù yǒu diǎn chà.
grammar.english: The service at this shop is a little poor.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo zǎo diǎn chū mén.
Wǒ zhǐ shì kāi wán xiào, bié shēng qì.
grammar.english: I'm just joking; don't be angry.

grammar.pinyin: Tā tīng wán zhè ge gù shi jiù xiào le.
grammar.english: He laughed as soon as he heard the story.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān huí qu xiū xi.
grammar.english: I want to go back and rest first.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng dǎ kāi chuāng hu.
Nǐ kě yǐ huí dá zhè ge wèn tí ma?
Qǐng jì zhu zhè ge míng zi.
Wǒ men zài chē zhàn jiàn miàn.
Wǒ měi tiān dōu chī shuǐ guǒ.
Wǒ men jīn tiān méi yǒu kè.
Wǒ wàng le dài yào shi.
grammar.english: I forgot to bring my keys.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kàn yí xià dì tú.
grammar.english: I want to take a quick look at the map.
grammar.source: Context: softened request with 一下

grammar.pinyin: Tā míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì.
Wǒ men míng tiān kě yǐ jiàn miàn ma?
Míng tiān shì tā de shēng ri.
Nǐ de jiàn yì hěn yǒu yòng.
Nà ge lǎo ren zhèng zài sàn bù.
grammar.english: That elderly person is taking a walk.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ ge chéng shì?
grammar.english: Which city do you want to visit?

grammar.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zuò dì tiě qù shàng xué.
grammar.english: He takes the metro to school every day.

grammar.pinyin: Bù yòng děng wǒ, nǐ xiān zǒu.
grammar.english: You don't need to wait for me; go ahead.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng jiān hěn gān jìng.
Bié dān xīn, wǒ huì bāng máng.
Zhè méi shén me, nǐ bù yòng dān xīn.
grammar.english: It's nothing; you don't need to worry.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ méi yǒu tīng cuò.
Wǒ men míng tiān zài jiàn.
Wài miàn hěn lěng, wǒ men jìn qu ba.
grammar.english: It's cold outside; let's go inside.

grammar.pinyin: Tā yǐ qián zài guó wài gōng zuò guo.
Qǐng xiān zuò xià.
Wǒ zhǎo bù dào qián bāo le.
Wǒ men kě yǐ huàn ge dì diǎn jiàn miàn.
Nǐ qù guo nǎ xiē guó jiā?
Zhè ge dá àn bù duì.
Wǒ yī huì r gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà.
grammar.english: I'll call you in a little while.
